notes.title: Shawn's Story delay T_T
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/0d74ec4547ba88c66a649ddf6cc085a2425662d6.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]We are very sorry but due to unforeseen circumstances Shawn's story will be delayed 2 weeks from the 15th of September to the 30th of September. We are doing our best to polish it and make it as good and complete as possible before release (we might have a few harem options missing at release time).[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]You can check it on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795260"]Steam store[/url]! (Please wishlist it, it helps a LOT!)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795260"][/dynamiclink]Thanks a lot to our artist & dev team.[/p][p align="start"]We also now have a Developer page on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/andrealphusgames"]Steam[/url].[/p][p align="start"][b]Andrealphus[/b][/p]

notes.title: The store page for Shawn's story is up on Steam!
notes.content: [p]Hi guys :)[/p][p][/p][p]Today I wanted to talk to you about "Shawn's story", as we crossed the Rubicon on it: it is on the [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795260"]Steam store[/url][/b]! (Please wishlist it)[/p][p][/p][p]So what is it about? It's a smaller Love & Sex (the size of FAFOW, a third of BreeMC or 15% of MikeMC, so 3 girls) focused on Shawn, Palla, Amy and Audrey.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/b8bd953244ddeed7596b66163691ad6ef8c7172a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It will be available in alpha to our VIP patrons next month and will be released on Steam, [url="https://itch.io/"][b]Itch.io[/b][/url] and Patreon in September as a full game (no Early Access).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/479eeae22a927409cdb7d07aac44cda5899e65be.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For now, only those three girls are planned, BUT if you like it and want more, we could be adding one or two to the package.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/33691b3eee3f12eb88df0b80216760f469f81e0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This will also be the time for us to test new things and see if we wanna add them to Mike (Like visiting Palla and Audrey in their apartments).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/13a11a81068140ae5cc39d24898808b5f65b0269.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hopefully you'll have fun with Shawn (and if you do, we will hold a poll to decide on another lucky character to get its spin-off, maybe Dwayne or Jack).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044432/2483fce4d3855d50d16c75978586a9e770e7668b.jpg"][/img][/p][p] Thanks a lot to our artist & dev team.  [/p][p]Have fun ;)  [/p][p][b]Andrealphus[/b][/p]
